counter_passages.interpretation: Qualifying ratifications alone are candidates for automatic approval. The tenant-scoped maximum of two and boundary-wide maximum of six use inclusive 86,400-second windows and select approved automatic ratification history. The tenant is the reviewed league value shared across its referees. Championship requests and qualifying requests over either limit use one league-supervisor approval.
counter_passages.operator_clarification: For this new two-behavior revision, apply the automatic limits only to ratifications: two per league and six overall in the rolling 24 hours, retaining the existing ratification approval history. Withdrawals always require supervisor review and do not consume or expand those automatic ratification allowances. Keep every other ratification, withdrawal and Read requirement unchanged.
counter_passages.next_step: Retain both ratification-only history selectors, scopes, maxima, and inclusive rolling windows.

counting_requirement_bindings.source_excerpt: Valid qualifying-stage results may be approved automatically, with at most six automatic ratifications overall and two per league in the inclusive rolling 24-hour window. Qualifying results beyond either cap go to human review. Every valid championship-stage result requires the league supervisor's human review. Counts are shared across that league's referees; creating a local client does not create more allowance. Explicit supervised execution follows approval. Request a stored Runner-ledger receipt and independently verify the changed source row. No match server or external system is contacted.
